name: CEI
description: CEI land-cover classes. Labels are authored as RGB in data/raw/review/*_mask.tif and exported to single-channel class-ID masks by rgb_to_class_id.py.

classes.name: Unlabeled
classes.definition: Cannot be determined. Excluded from the loss via ignore_index.

classes.name: Rangeland
classes.definition: Rangeland, grass, shrubs, parks, golf courses, uncultivated vegetation.

classes.name: Water
classes.definition: Rivers, lakes, ponds, dams, sea, swimming pools.

classes.name: Non-vegetated
classes.definition: Sport surfaces, bareland, pavement, sidewalk, parking lots, sand, rocks, exposed soil, non-vegetated natural surface.
